outcome: Perform confidently in solo and ensemble settings, using voice and instruments fluently, accurately and expressively.
Improvise and compose, developing ideas from a range of structures, styles, genres and traditions.
Use staff and other notations accurately across musical styles, genres and traditions.
Identify and use the inter-related dimensions of music expressively, including tonalities, scales and other devices.
Listen with increasing discrimination to a wide range of music from great composers and musicians.
Deepen understanding of the music performed and heard, and its history.
